newsitem.title: USA: Penn Traffic Q2 same-store sales fell.
newsitem.headline: Penn Traffic Q2 same-store sales fell.

text.p: Penn Traffic Co said Wednesday revenues for the second quarter ended August 2, 1997 were approximately $774 million, a decrease of 8.2 percent from the prior year. Same store sales decreased 7.7 percent for the quarter.

Revenues for the 26-week period ended August 2, 1997 were approximately $1.533 billion, a decrease of 8.2 percent from the prior year. Same store sales for the 26-week period ended August 2, 1997 decreased 7.9 percent from the prior year.
The Penn Traffic Company expects to report its second quarter financial results on September 4, 1997.
